WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx,
         AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_ownership_difference
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS overall_avg_ownership_difference
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT e.corpeventprx,
       e.avg_anlycount,
       e.avg_ownership_difference,
       e.avg_ownership_difference - o.overall_avg_ownership_difference
         AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM event_averages AS e
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_ownership_difference IS NOT NULL
